senses.gloss:
Paitāmaha
--Maghānakṣatrajananaśānti acc. to. Mysore N. D. IV. A. 11785. IV. B. Extr. p. 369. IV. A. 11790.
--Rāhuśānti acc. to. Mysore N. D. IV. A. 12040.
C.. Pitāmahasmṛti above.

Paitāmahasiddhānta
also called Brahmasiddhānta. Often q. by Brahmagupta.
See Colebrooke, Misc. Essays. II. p. 457.
See also Pitāmahasiddhānta.

Paitāmahasiddhānta
from Viṣṇudharmottarapurāṇa.
On this see David Pingree, Adyar Library Bulletin 31-32. p.. 472-510.

Paitāmahī
jy. by Madhusūdana, son of Śrīpati an. grandson of Gopīrāja. BORI. 424 of 1895-98. Peters. VI. Extr. p. 33 (no. 424).
--C. by Gopīrāja, son of Rāmakṛṣṇa of Bhāradvājagotra. Baroda II. 9221 (inc.). Peters. VI. Extr. p. 33 (no. 424).
See also Paitāmahīsāriṇī below.

Paitāmahībhāṣya
jy. by Brahmagupta. Q. by Dādābhāi in C. Kiraṇāvalī on Sūryasiddhānta, Cambr. 45.

Paitāmahībhāṣyavivaraṇa
jy. by Caturvedācārya or Pṛthūdakasvāmin. Q. by Dādābhāī in C. Kiraṇāvalī on Sūryasiddhānta, Cambr. 45.

Paitāmahīsāriṇī
jy. by Madhusūdanadaivajña. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1903, p. 6 (no. 1049) (inc.).

Paitārya
See Pettārācārya above.

Paitīśavola_(?)
Jain. JASB. 1908, p. 425b (nos. 7129. 7239). [Page199-b]

Paitṛkakriyā
dh. on funeral rites. Oppert I. 7480.

Paitṛkatithinirṇaya
dh. by Cakradhara. B. III. 104.

Paitṛkaprayoga
Āpast. Viśvabhāratī 1779 (b).

Paitṛkavihāra
śr. Ānandāśrama 2032.
--Baudh. on the construction of sacrificial halls. ASB. I. ii. 1088. RASB. II. 787.

Paitṛmedhasūtra
Ujjain I. p. 11.
C.. Pitṛmedhasūtra above.

Paitṛmedhika
dh. Oppert I. 7558.
See also Pitṛmedhika above.

Paitṛmedhika
Āśval. by Yallāji, son of Yallubhaṭṭa. Hz. 58 (2 mss.). 150. 418 (inc.). Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 52.
See Āśval. paitṛmedhikaprayoga, NCC. II. p. 221a.

Paitṛmedhikakarman
IO. 5550 (2) (inc.).

Paitṛmedhikatantra

Paitṛmedhikaprayoga

--Bhārad. by Trimallayajvan. ASB. I. iii. 727 (a..). BISM. v.. 749/22. IM. 1908 (a. Trimalla Jaina).
